description: Weekly time card: add shifts (start and end "HH:MM", unpaid break minutes; an end at or before the start is an overnight shift), up to 6 shifts a day. Totals per shift, per day and per week in h:mm and decimal hours; optional rounding of each shift to 5, 6 or 15 minutes; overtime over N hours a day and/or N regular hours a week (daily first, then weekly), paid at a multiplier (default 1.5); pay at an hourly rate. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/hours-calc/

dailyOvertimeHours.description: Hours per day after which time is overtime (e.g. 8).

roundMinutes.description: Round each shift to the nearest 5, 6 or 15 minutes (0 = off).

end.description: End time, 24 h "HH:MM" (at or before start = next day).

weekOf.description: Optional: any date in that week (YYYY-MM-DD) to date each day.

weekStart.description: First day of the week (order of the days).

weeklyOvertimeHours.description: Regular hours per week after which time is overtime (e.g. 40).

name: calc_hours
title: Work hours / time card
